title: Maximum Chidori
body:
Syntax: perform maximum chidori <target>

Description: The strongest Chidori in this set, with a chance to paralyze.  Requires Lightning chakra nature. Base damage: 1509-1789. 30% chance to inflict paralyzed. Unlocks at level 75. Costs 72 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 5 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
